title: Modular Monolith Domain Ownership and Boundary Inventory — structured inventory
phase: F2 PREPARATION — Modular Monolith Boundary Definition
type: READ-ONLY ARCHITECTURE DISCOVERY (evidence files only, no code/schema/index change)

baseline.worktree_isolation: A fresh isolated git worktree, separate from the primary worktree and from PR #268's worktree, was used for this task. The author-machine local filesystem path is deliberately omitted from this evidence — it is not portable/reproducible information and carries no evidentiary value beyond confirming isolation, which this field states directly.

methodology: This inventory does NOT re-derive domain ownership from zero. It inherits the already repository-evidence-verified, F0-008-reviewed baseline produced by F0-003 (MODULE_MAP.md / F0-003_module_ownership_inventory.json, pinned to commit 368bcc8d) and F0-004 (DEPENDENCY_MAP.md / F0-004_dependency_inventory.json) — 37 domains, 88 Prisma models, an 833-edge cross-domain dependency matrix, already cited as evidence by ADR-001/ADR-014/ADR-015 (ACCEPTED / ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS). Re-deriving that evidence from zero would duplicate already-accepted work and risks silently contradicting it. Instead, this task (1) reconciled the F0-003/F0-004 baseline commit (368bcc8d) against the current origin/main HEAD (70b1690c) via targeted `git diff --stat`/`--name-status` scoped to server/src/routes, server/src/services, server/prisma/schema.prisma, src/pages, src/components; (2) classified every file/model touched by that diff; (3) added one new domain (External Calendar Integration) and extended three existing domains (Privacy/Consent/Retention/DSR, Platform Administration, Storage Abstraction) whose evidence changed; (4) added the 4-bucket Prisma-model ownership-category classification (DOMAIN_OWNED/SHARED_KERNEL_CANDIDATE/PLATFORM_INFRASTRUCTURE/OWNERSHIP_AMBIGUOUS) required by this task, which F0-003 did not use; (5) added the target-module-shape recommendation required by this task. All 37 inherited domains are unchanged in identity/name/models from the accepted MODULE_MAP.md unless explicitly noted in that domain's `evidenceSource` field.

codegraph_usage.result: UNAVAILABLE — `codegraph` is not an installed CLI/PATH-resolvable tool in this environment (confirmed via `which codegraph` -> not found, and direct invocation -> "command not found"). This is at minimum the seventh independent confirmation of CodeGraph unavailability across this program (see CURRENT_PHASE.md F1-003-P2-R2 entry, "sixth+ independent confirmation").
codegraph_usage.fallback: Bounded `Read`/`Grep`/`Glob`/`git diff` scoped strictly to server/src/{routes,services,jobs}, server/prisma/schema.prisma, server/src/index.ts (route mounting), server/package.json, package.json, src/pages, src/components — matching the F0-003 CODEGRAPH DISCIPLINE-scoped root set. No whole-project exploratory scan was run.
